# Feature flags and environment variables

Everything below defaults to **off** or unset (the tables are generated from `src/lib/flags/registry.ts`; run `npm run flags:docs` after changing it). A flag is on only for the exact value `1`. Variables named `NEXT_PUBLIC_*` are inlined at **build** time (changing one needs a rebuild); all others are read at run time.

<!-- flags:generated:start -->

<!-- Generated by `npm run flags:docs` from src/lib/flags/registry.ts. Do not edit between these markers: change the registry and regenerate. `npm run flags:check` fails on a difference. -->

The registry holds **158** environment names: **51** on/off switches (**19** build-time), 55 config values, 28 credentials, 10 host-provided and 14 test and tooling names. Names marked _arrives with_ belong to a branch that is not merged yet.

### Safety switches and blocked flags

A blocked flag is rejected in every profile and every environment.

| Name | When | Default | Owner | What it enables | Depends on | Conflicts with | Effects |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `PARTNER_ALLOW_SAMPLE` | run | off | partners | Allows the made-up sample partner source in production. | PARTNER_SOURCE=sample [FR-03] | VERCEL_ENV=production [FR-14] | - |
| `SSO_ONLY` | run | off | auth | Hides the password form so everyone signs in through single sign-on. | SSO_ENABLED=1 [FR-15]; SSO_BREAK_GLASS_EMAILS set [FR-15] | - | - |
| `AI_KILL_SWITCH` | run | off | ai-gateway | When 1, the AI gateway refuses every model call before anything is sent. Unlike most flags, ON here means AI is OFF. | - | - | AI |
| `WA_META_WINDOW` | run | off | whatsapp | Enforces the 24-hour customer-service window for WhatsApp replies. | - | - | - |
| `CONSENT_ENFORCEMENT` | run | off | consent | The consent gate in the nudger, CleverTap push, ingest, reply assist, outcomes and referral drafts. | NEXT_PUBLIC_CONSENT=1 [FR-20, warn] | - | PII |
| `PUSH_DRY_RUN` | run | off | push | Logs a push message instead of sending it (local checks without a Firebase project). | - | VERCEL_ENV=production [FR-04, warn] | - |
| `AUTOPILOT_APPLY_ENABLED` _(arrives with autopilot)_ | run | off | autopilot | Would apply ad changes through the platform APIs. | - | on in any profile [FR-05] | vendor-sharing |
| `CLOSED_LOOP_KILL_SWITCH` _(arrives with closedloop)_ | run | off | closedloop | Stops every conversion send. | - | - | - |
| `CLOSED_LOOP_DEMO` _(arrives with closedloop)_ | run | off | closedloop | A fake, no-network conversion destination. | - | VERCEL_ENV=production [FR-13] | - |
| `DEMO_MODE` _(arrives with demo)_ | run | off | demo | A local AI stand-in, a network guard and the demo seed: nothing leaves the machine. | DEMO_MODE = NEXT_PUBLIC_DEMO_MODE [FR-13] | CLEVERTAP_PUSH_ENABLED=1 [FR-13]; AGENT_NUDGER_ENABLED=1 [FR-13]; WA_ASSIST_AUTO=1 [FR-13]; VERCEL_ENV=production [FR-13]; a non-local DATABASE_URL [FR-13]; CLOSED_LOOP_CONVERSIONS_ENABLED=1 and not (CLOSED_LOOP_DEMO=1) [FR-13] | - |

### Validation rules

`validateFlags(env)` checks these. In a production start the safety rules (FR-05, FR-10, FR-11, FR-13, FR-14) stop the boot; every other finding is logged once and shown on the Flags tab. Set `FLAG_CHECK=warn` to downgrade a failed check (break-glass, logged loudly). In development and CI everything is reported.

| Rule | Severity | Checks |
| --- | --- | --- |
| FR-01 | error | Unknown name: a NEXT_PUBLIC_* name, or a name read in the source, that is not in the registry |
| FR-02 | error | Bad value: a bool that is not 1 (true, yes and on are silently off), or an enum, int or url that does not parse |
| FR-03 | error | A requirement of the flag is not satisfied |
| FR-04 | error | A conflict of the flag is present |
| FR-05 | error | A blocked flag is on (autonomous ad-spend changes) |
| FR-10 | error | Outbound or vendor-sharing needs consent enforcement and the consent screens |
| FR-11 | error | Closed-loop conversions need the full consent chain and may not be record-only for ads measurement |
| FR-12 | error | AI features need a provider key (error) and a recorded sign-off (warning: not readable from env) |
| FR-13 | error | No live outbound, production or hosted database under demo; the build-time twin must match |
| FR-14 | error | Sample partner data conflicts with a production environment |
| FR-15 | error | Single sign-on pairing: SSO_ONLY needs SSO and a break-glass list; SSO needs its three settings |
| FR-16 | error | Secret and setting pairing, and the always-required secrets |
| FR-20 | warn | Soft prerequisite: a screen that renders empty or unreachable without another flag (an error in profiles for the marketing-gated four) |
| FR-30 | warn | Build-time mismatch: a NEXT_PUBLIC_* value differs from what the running bundle was built with (a rebuild is pending) |
| FR-31 | warn | Deprecated or unreferenced registered flag: registered, but nothing in the source reads it |

- **demo**: The demo on a laptop: every screen on, no network side effects. Off on purpose: every real outbound flag (CleverTap writes, the nudger, reply auto-draft) and the blocked Autopilot apply switch. Closed-loop runs only against its fake destination. AI answers come from the local stand-in that DEMO_MODE provides.
- **pilot**: Real data, a small named group of RMs, drafts only. The reply assistant needs a recorded AI pilot sign-off and the person on the pilot list (Settings, AI pilot). Marketing, partner, referral and outbound push are off.
- **go-live**: The whole firm, real customers. Live messaging (CleverTap writes, the nudger) and closed-loop conversions are left commented out: each runs only after the owner's approval. The sample paths and addresses are placeholders.
- **marketing-only**: The marketing hire's environment: marketing surfaces on, nothing customer-facing for RMs. RM-side feature flags are off. Attribution shows no Customer 360 journey tab on purpose (a warning, not an error). Autopilot is read-only.
- **all-on**: CI and layout-budget runs only; never deployed. Every feature flag on, with consent enforcement. Off on purpose: demo mode, the closed-loop fake destination, sample partner data, SSO_ONLY and the blocked Autopilot apply switch. Outbound flags are on only because CI injects fakes and holds no keys and no network; it is validated with assumeCredentials and never deployed.

## How the partner and referral flags combine

The partner first touch is written by the lead intake only when `PARTNER_WORKSPACE_ENABLED=1`; the referral hook runs only when `REFERRAL_PROGRAM_ENABLED=1`. A partner code is always the partner's; a customer referral that also matches is recorded and flagged for review only when the partner credit was written. See `docs/referrals.md`.
